title: 2020 roadmap on pore materials for energy and environmental applications
claim: MOF-mediated precursor synthesis is presented as more feasible than direct use of many pristine MOFs for demanding electrocatalytic conditions.
explanation: The review points to instability under the high-pH conditions associated with favorable oxygen-evolution kinetics and to the insulating or modestly conducting character of many MOFs.
scope: MOF electrocatalysts, particularly for oxygen evolution.
conditions: Strongly alkaline reaction conditions are a central concern.
caveats: This is a comparative assessment of many existing MOFs, not a claim that no pristine MOF can function as an electrocatalyst.
